description:
Make a LinkedIn-size social image for one account, in a catalog design system. Pass the account's company, website, offer and call-to-action link. Better Design writes the headline when you leave it out, and draws the image.

Each call spends 2 Better Design credits and returns public links at once: `viewUrl` shows progress, then the image's page; `imageUrl` is the PNG once it is ready. Take `designSystemId` from find-design-system. It needs a Better Design account with a verified email.

ctaUrl.description: Where the call to action goes, for example your calendar link.

designSystemId.description: A catalog design system id from find-design-system, for example "cashmere". It sets the colours and type.

headline.description: Optional. The image's headline. Left out, Better Design writes it.

notes.description: Optional. What you know about the account: its business, its problem, the conversation so far.

offer.description: What you offer this account and what it gets.

website.description: The account's website, for example https://acme.com.

name: make-social-image
title: Make a Social Image
